jobs.occupation: Kitchen Help Industrial Kitchen - Aalter - 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or a perfectly cooked roast beef: you’ll be licking your fingers and thumbs. And in this role, you’ll make sure others can do the same. In our kitchen, we create dishes that would make grandmothers jealous—but on an industrial scale, in large quantities.

We’re looking for a Kitchen Help for a food company in Aalter!

Hygiene is crucial for a kitchen staff member. That’s why you’ll ensure every day that your work methods and the final products meet all standards.

You’ll also follow safety regulations to the letter. You’ll do everything in your power to guarantee both quality and safety.    

Who are you?

• You have experience as a cook in a commercial or industrial kitchen. Do you also have experience in a production environment? If so, that’s a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system.
• The early shift starts at 4:30 a.m. and runs until 12:30 p.m.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 p.m. and runs until 8:00 p.m. 
• You know how to operate machinery or are willing to undergo training for this.
• Physical work doesn’t deter you, and you’re hands-on.
• You work with great precision and are flexible and able to handle stress.
• You’re a good communicator, enjoy variety, and like working in a team.
• You speak Dutch or English well.

What does a Critical Infrastructure NOC Manager do at LCL? 
 

As a Critical Infrastructure NOC Manager, you will contribute to building a standardized and scalable NOC operation across all data center sites. You will share responsibility for the daily operational management and ongoing development of the NOC. You will develop, implement, and optimize processes, procedures, runbooks, and incident management practices to ensure the NOC team responds quickly, accurately, and consistently to alarms, incidents, and operational challenges. 
 

In addition, you will establish a strong training and knowledge management framework. Through onboarding programs, training initiatives, and hands-on simulations, you will strengthen the technical expertise and decision-making capabilities of NOC employees. You will coach, motivate, and develop a team of 12 NOC professionals working in a continuous 24/7 operational environment. You will ensure strict adherence to incident management procedures by training operators, monitoring compliance with escalation paths, customer communication standards, and reporting requirements, and driving continuous process improvement. You will oversee the quality of monitoring, alarm handling, incident response, and ticket management processes, ensuring that critical alerts receive prompt and appropriate attention. As a key link between the NOC, field technicians, technical experts, IT teams, and external partners, you will foster efficient collaboration and clear communication across all sites.
 

You will report directly to the Critical Infrastructure Manager. Your primary workplace will be Aalst, with regular coordination and collaboration across LCL’s other locations.

Is this the right opportunity for you?
 
 

• You hold at least a bachelor's degree, preferably in a technical field, or have acquired equivalent knowledge through relevant experience. 

• You have previous experience leading technical teams and know how to coach, motivate, and develop employees, preferably within a 24/7 or continuous operations environment. 

• You have experience with operational processes in a technical or critical infrastructure environment. Experience in a data center or NOC environment is a strong asset. 

• You possess solid technical knowledge of electrical systems and HVAC and are familiar with monitoring tools, BMS and/or DCIM systems. 

• You have a process-oriented mindset, bring structure to complex environments, and develop clear procedures. You document accurately and ensure knowledge remains up to date. 

• You have strong analytical skills, quickly identify patterns and root causes, and translate insights into sustainable improvements. Experience with change management and continuous improvement initiatives is a significant advantage. 

• You communicate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders, promote standardized ways of working, and actively encourage knowledge sharing and coaching. You are comfortable providing guidance and corrective feedback when needed. 

• You have a good command of Dutch, French, and English, both spoken and written.

Based in our Brussels office, you will work in close, direct collaboration with the Global Director of Brand & Digital Marketing and the wider international Marketing team, to ensure the consistency, quality and visibility of digital content across our hotels' distribution and booking platforms. A.Collection knowledge
-Develop an in-depth understanding of the hotels in the collection, their positioning and unique features.
-Become fully familiar with the group's brand standards and digital ecosystem.

B.Digital content audits
-Conduct detailed audits of content across the official website, booking engine, OTAs (Booking.com, Expedia, etc.), Google Business Profile, B2B/MICE platforms (Cvent) and other partner platforms.

C.Content harmonization and updates
-Ensure consistency of information across platforms: hotel descriptions, room categories and names, amenities and services, visual content and photo libraries, editorial tone and brand image.
-Continuously update and optimize content.

D.Search engine and AI model (LLM) optimization
-Optimize content structure and markup (structured data, schema.org, llms.txt files, FAQ content, etc.) to maximize visibility and accuracy across search engines and generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Copilot, etc.).
-Regularly audit how the collection's hotels are represented in AI-generated answers, identify gaps or inaccurate information, and coordinate corrections.
-Support the improvement of quality and standardization of hotel data to help AI systems interpret it correctly.

E.Monitoring and continuous improvement in generative AI
-Actively track the fast-moving evolution of large language models (LLMs) and AI-powered search tools, along with emerging best practices (GEO ¿ Generative Engine Optimization, AEO ¿ Answer Engine Optimization).
-Translate this ongoing monitoring into concrete recommendations and continuously adjust content strategy as algorithms and tools evolve.
-Share learnings and best practices with the Marketing team and other stakeholders across the group. F.Liaison with the collection's hotels
-Act as the main point of contact for hotel properties' local teams for the collection, validation and regular updating of their content (information, photos, offers, events).
-Maintain regular follow-up with each property to ensure responsiveness, reliability and freshness of content across all platforms.

G.Content moderation and quality control
-Moderate, review and approve all content published on the collection's hotel websites prior to going live.
-Ensure compliance with editorial guidelines, brand standards, legal requirements and accessibility norms across all platforms.
 

H.Technical and cross-functional coordination
-Work with IT/web development teams, hotel properties and external agencies to resolve technical issues (broken links, outdated pages, faulty forms).
-Coordinate translation and localization of content across the collection's markets and languages.
-Manage a publishing calendar and prioritize update requests coming from individual properties.

I.Monitoring, reporting and continuous improvement
-Provide regular reporting on content quality, compliance and performance (KPIs, dashboards).
-Stay current on best practices in content moderation, SEO and user experience.
 
-Degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Communications, Hospitality Management or a related field.
-First experience in web content management or moderation, ideally within the hospitality, travel, or a multi-site environment.
-Experience with one or more CMS platforms (WordPress or equivalent) and web analytics tools (Google Analytics, Search Console).
-Excellent attention to detail, rigor, and a strong sense of editorial and legal compliance.
-Genuine interest in the hospitality industry and digital environments.
-Strong analytical and coordination skills, comfortable managing multiple priorities across a multi-market environment.
-Proficiency with digital platforms and content management tools.
-Genuine curiosity about generative AI technologies (LLMs) and their impact on digital discoverability; willingness to continuously learn in this fast-evolving field.
-Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, comfortable liaising with multiple stakeholders (hotels, internal teams, external partners).
-Excellent written and spoken French and English; any additional language is an asset.
